versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: נְקֹ֗ם נִקְמַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֖ת הַמִּדְיָנִ֑ים אַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵ֥ף אֶל־עַמֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: “Avenge the children of Israel for the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
controles.kjv: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
controles.livre: Faze a vingança dos filhos de Israel sobre os midianitas; depois serás recolhido a teus povos.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר הֵחָלְצ֧וּ מֵאִתְּכֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וְיִהְיוּ֙ עַל־מִדְיָ֔ן לָתֵ֥ת נִקְמַת־יְהוָ֖ה בְּמִדְיָֽן׃

controles.web: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.
controles.kjv: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the Lord of Midian.
controles.livre: Então Moisés falou ao povo, dizendo: Armai-vos alguns de vós para a guerra, e irão contra Midiã, e farão a vingança do SENHOR em Midiã.

versos.hebraico: אֶ֚לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה לְכֹל֙ מַטּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תִּשְׁלְח֖וּ לַצָּבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.”
controles.kjv: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
controles.livre: Mil de cada tribo de todas as tribos dos filhos de Israel, enviareis à guerra.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּמָּֽסְרוּ֙ מֵאַלְפֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
controles.kjv: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
controles.livre: Assim foram dados dos milhares de Israel, mil cada tribo, doze mil a ponto de guerra.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶ֥לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֖ה לַצָּבָ֑א אֹ֠תָם וְאֶת־פִּ֨ינְחָ֜ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לַצָּבָ֔א וּכְלֵ֥י הַקֹּ֛דֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַתְּרוּעָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
controles.kjv: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
controles.livre: E Moisés os enviou à guerra: mil cada tribo enviou: e Fineias, filho de Eleazar sacerdote, foi à guerra com os santos instrumentos, com as trombetas em sua mão para tocar.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּצְבְּאוּ֙ עַל־מִדְיָ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כָּל־זָכָֽר׃

controles.web: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.
controles.kjv: And they warred against the Midianites, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
controles.livre: E lutaram contra Midiã, como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés, e mataram a todo homem.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־מַלְכֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן הָרְג֣וּ עַל־חַלְלֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־רֶ֨קֶם֙ וְאֶת־צ֤וּר וְאֶת־חוּר֙ וְאֶת־רֶ֔בַע חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֵת֙ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־בְּע֔וֹר הָרְג֖וּ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
controles.kjv: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
controles.livre: Mataram também, entre os mortos deles, aos reis de Midiã: Evi, e Requém, e Zur, e Hur, e Reba, cinco reis de Midiã; a Balaão também, filho de Beor, mataram à espada.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁבּ֧וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־נְשֵׁ֥י מִדְיָ֖ן וְאֶת־טַפָּ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־בְּהֶמְתָּ֧ם וְאֶת־כָּל־מִקְנֵהֶ֛ם וְאֶת־כָּל־חֵילָ֖ם בָּזָֽזוּ׃

controles.web: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
controles.livre: E levaram cativas os filhos de Israel as mulheres dos midianitas, e suas crianças e todos suas animais, e todos os seus gados; e arrebataram todos os seus pertences.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־עָרֵיהֶם֙ בְּמ֣וֹשְׁבֹתָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־טִֽירֹתָ֑ם שָׂרְפ֖וּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burnt with fire.
controles.kjv: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
controles.livre: E abrasaram com fogo todas suas cidades, aldeias e castelos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַשָּׁלָ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־הַמַּלְק֑וֹחַ בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה׃

controles.web: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
controles.kjv: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
controles.livre: E tomaram todo o despojo, e toda a presa, tanto de homens como de animais.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבִ֡אוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֩ וְאֶל־אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְאֶל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־הַשְּׁבִ֧י וְאֶת־הַמַּלְק֛וֹחַ וְאֶת־הַשָּׁלָ֖ל אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה אֶל־עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: They brought the captives, and the prey, and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
controles.kjv: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
controles.livre: E trouxeram a Moisés, e a Eleazar o sacerdote, e à congregação dos filhos de Israel, os cativos e a presa e os despojos, ao acampamento nas planícies de Moabe, que estão junto ao Jordão de Jericó.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְכָל־נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לִקְרָאתָ֑ם אֶל־מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

controles.web: Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
controles.kjv: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
controles.livre: E saíram Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote, e todos os príncipes da congregação, a recebê-los fora do acampamento.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְצֹ֣ף מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַ֖ל פְּקוּדֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל שָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֔וֹת הַבָּאִ֖ים מִצְּבָ֥א הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
controles.kjv: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
controles.livre: E irou-se Moisés contra os capitães do exército, contra os comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem que voltavam da guerra;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֑ה הַֽחִיִּיתֶ֖ם כָּל־נְקֵבָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
controles.livre: E disse-lhes Moisés: Todas as mulheres preservastes?

versos.hebraico: הֵ֣ן הֵ֜נָּה הָי֨וּ לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֔ם לִמְסָר־מַ֥עַל בַּיהוָ֖ה עַל־דְּבַר־פְּע֑וֹר וַתְּהִ֥י הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה בַּעֲדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.
controles.livre: Eis que elas foram aos filhos de Israel, por conselho de Balaão, para causar transgressão contra o SENHOR no negócio de Peor; pelo que houve mortandade na congregação do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִרְג֥וּ כָל־זָכָ֖ר בַּטָּ֑ף וְכָל־אִשָּׁ֗ה יֹדַ֥עַת אִ֛ישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּ֥ב זָכָ֖ר הֲרֹֽגוּ׃

controles.web: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
controles.kjv: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
controles.livre: Matai, pois, agora todos os machos entre as crianças: matai também toda mulher que tenha conhecido homem carnalmente.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹל֙ הַטַּ֣ף בַּנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר הַחֲי֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
controles.kjv: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
controles.livre: E todas as meninas entre as mulheres, que não tenham conhecido ajuntamento de homem, vos preservareis vivas.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתֶּ֗ם חֲנ֛וּ מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כֹּל֩ הֹרֵ֨ג נֶ֜פֶשׁ וְכֹ֣ל׀ נֹגֵ֣עַ בֶּֽחָלָ֗ל תִּֽתְחַטְּא֞וּ בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י אַתֶּ֖ם וּשְׁבִיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Encamp outside of the camp seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
controles.kjv: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
controles.livre: E vós ficai fora do acampamento sete dias: e todos os que houverem matado pessoa, e qualquer um que houver tocado morto, vos purificareis ao terceiro e ao sétimo dia, vós e vossos cativos.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־בֶּ֧גֶד וְכָל־כְּלִי־ע֛וֹר וְכָל־מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה עִזִּ֖ים וְכָל־כְּלִי־עֵ֑ץ תִּתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃ס

controles.web: As to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify yourselves.”
controles.kjv: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.
controles.livre: Também purificareis toda roupa, e todo artigo de peles, e toda obra de pelos de cabra, e todo vaso de madeira.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַצָּבָ֔א הַבָּאִ֖ים לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses:
controles.kjv: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses;
controles.livre: E Eleazar o sacerdote disse aos homens de guerra que vinham da guerra: Esta é a ordenança da lei que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés:

versos.hebraico: אַ֥ךְ אֶת־הַזָּהָ֖ב וְאֶת־הַכָּ֑סֶף אֶֽת־הַנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֶת־הַבַּרְזֶ֔ל אֶֽת־הַבְּדִ֖יל וְאֶת־הָעֹפָֽרֶת׃

controles.web: however the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
controles.kjv: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
controles.livre: Certamente o ouro, e a prata, bronze, ferro, estanho, e chumbo,

versos.hebraico: כָּל־דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹ֣א בָאֵ֗שׁ תַּעֲבִ֤ירוּ בָאֵשׁ֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר אַ֕ךְ בְּמֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה יִתְחַטָּ֑א וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יָבֹ֛א בָּאֵ֖שׁ תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ בַמָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
controles.kjv: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
controles.livre: Tudo o que resiste ao fogo, por fogo o fareis passar, e será limpo, ainda que nas águas de purificação haverá de purificar-se: mas fareis passar por água tudo o que não aguenta o fogo.

versos.hebraico: וְכִבַּסְתֶּ֧ם בִּגְדֵיכֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם וְאַחַ֖ר תָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃פ

controles.web: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
controles.kjv: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
controles.livre: Além disso lavareis vossas roupas no sétimo dia, e assim sereis limpos; e depois entrareis no acampamento.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: שָׂ֗א אֵ֣ת רֹ֤אשׁ מַלְק֨וֹחַ֙ הַשְּׁבִ֔י בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה אַתָּה֙ וְאֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְרָאשֵׁ֖י אֲב֥וֹת הָעֵדָֽה׃

controles.web: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
controles.kjv: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
controles.livre: Toma a contagem da presa que se fez, tanto das pessoas como dos animais, tu e o sacerdote Eleazar, e os chefes dos pais da congregação:

versos.hebraico: וְחָצִ֨יתָ֙ אֶת־הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ בֵּ֚ין תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וּבֵ֖ין כָּל־הָעֵדָֽה׃

controles.web: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
controles.kjv: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
controles.livre: E partirás pela metade a presa entre os que lutaram, os que saíram à guerra, e toda a congregação.

versos.hebraico: וַהֲרֵמֹתָ֨ מֶ֜כֶס לַֽיהוָ֗ה מֵאֵ֞ת אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים לַצָּבָ֔א אֶחָ֣ד נֶ֔פֶשׁ מֵחֲמֵ֖שׁ הַמֵּא֑וֹת מִן־הָאָדָם֙ וּמִן־הַבָּקָ֔ר וּמִן־הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים וּמִן־הַצֹּֽאן׃

controles.web: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
controles.kjv: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
controles.livre: E separarás para o SENHOR o tributo dos homens de guerra, que saíram à guerra: de quinhentos um, tanto das pessoas como dos bois, dos asnos, e das ovelhas:

versos.hebraico: מִמַּֽחֲצִיתָ֖ם תִּקָּ֑חוּ וְנָתַתָּ֛ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.
controles.kjv: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the Lord.
controles.livre: Da metade deles o tomarás; e darás a Eleazar o sacerdote a oferta do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּחֲצִ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּקַּ֣ח׀ אֶחָ֣ד׀ אָחֻ֣ז מִן־הַחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים מִן־הָאָדָ֧ם מִן־הַבָּקָ֛ר מִן־הַחֲמֹרִ֥ים וּמִן־הַצֹּ֖אן מִכָּל־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתָם֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֕י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”
controles.kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.
controles.livre: E da metade pertencente aos filhos de Israel tomarás um de cinquenta, das pessoas, dos bois, dos asnos, e das ovelhas, de todo animal; e os darás aos levitas, que têm a guarda do tabernáculo do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E fizeram Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote como o SENHOR mandou a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִי֙ הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ יֶ֣תֶר הַבָּ֔ז אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּזְז֖וּ עַ֣ם הַצָּבָ֑א צֹ֗אן שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵֽשֶׁת־אֲלָפִֽים׃

controles.web: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
controles.kjv: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
controles.livre: E foi a presa, o resto da presa que tomaram os homens de guerra, seiscentas e setenta e cinco mil ovelhas,

versos.hebraico: וּבָקָ֕ר שְׁנַ֥יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: and seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
controles.kjv: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
controles.livre: E setenta e dois mil bois,

versos.hebraico: וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים אֶחָ֥ד וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: and sixty-one thousand donkeys,
controles.kjv: And threescore and one thousand asses,
controles.livre: E setenta e um mil asnos;

versos.hebraico: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם מִן־הַ֨נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר כָּל־נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁנַ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
controles.kjv: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
controles.livre: E quanto às pessoas, de mulheres que não conheciam ajuntamento de homem, ao todo trinta e duas mil.

versos.hebraico: וַתְּהִי֙ הַֽמֶּחֱצָ֔ה חֵ֕לֶק הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים בַּצָּבָ֑א מִסְפַּ֣ר הַצֹּ֗אן שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְשִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:
controles.kjv: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
controles.livre: E a metade, a parte dos que haviam saído à guerra, foi o número de trezentas trinta e sete mil e quinhentas ovelhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֛י הַמֶּ֥כֶס לַֽיהוָ֖ה מִן־הַצֹּ֑אן שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָמֵ֥שׁ וְשִׁבְעִֽים׃

controles.web: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
controles.kjv: And the Lord’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
controles.livre: E o tributo para o SENHOR das ovelhas foi seiscentas e setenta e cinco.

versos.hebraico: וְהַ֨בָּקָ֔ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּמִכְסָ֥ם לַיהוָ֖ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְשִׁבְעִֽים׃

controles.web: The cattle were thirty-six thousand; of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.
controles.kjv: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the Lord’s tribute was threescore and twelve.
controles.livre: E dos bois, trinta e seis mil: e deles o tributo para o SENHOR, setenta e dois.

versos.hebraico: וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וּמִכְסָ֥ם לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֶחָ֥ד וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃

controles.web: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred; of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.
controles.kjv: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the Lord’s tribute was threescore and one.
controles.livre: E dos asnos, trinta mil e quinhentos: e deles o tributo para o SENHOR, setenta e um.

versos.hebraico: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וּמִכְסָם֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: The persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
controles.kjv: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the Lord’s tribute was thirty and two persons.
controles.livre: E das pessoas, dezesseis mil: e delas o tributo para o SENHOR, trinta e duas pessoas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶת־מֶ֨כֶס֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the Lord’s heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E deu Moisés o tributo, por elevada oferta ao SENHOR, a Eleazar o sacerdote, como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ חָצָ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַצֹּבְאִֽים׃

controles.web: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
controles.kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
controles.livre: E da metade para os filhos de Israel, que separou Moisés dos homens que haviam ido à guerra;

versos.hebraico: וַתְּהִ֛י מֶחֱצַ֥ת הָעֵדָ֖ה מִן־הַצֹּ֑אן שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
controles.kjv: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
controles.livre: (A metade para a congregação foi: das ovelhas, trezentas e trinta e sete mil e quinhentas;

versos.hebraico: וּבָקָ֕ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: and thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
controles.kjv: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
controles.livre: E dos bois, trinta e seis mil;

versos.hebraico: וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
controles.kjv: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
controles.livre: E dos asnos, trinta mil e quinhentos;

versos.hebraico: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: and sixteen thousand persons),
controles.kjv: And sixteen thousand persons;)
controles.livre: E das pessoas, dezesseis mil:)

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִמַּחֲצִ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־הָֽאָחֻז֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־הַחֲמִשִּׁ֔ים מִן־הָאָדָ֖ם וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתָ֜ם לַלְוִיִּ֗ם שֹֽׁמְרֵי֙ מִשְׁמֶ֨רֶת֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: Even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Da metade, pois, para os filhos de Israel tomou Moisés um de cada cinquenta, tanto das pessoas como dos animais, e deu-os aos levitas, que tinham a guarda do tabernáculo do SENHOR; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַפְּקֻדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַלְפֵ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א שָׂרֵ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
controles.kjv: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
controles.livre: E chegaram a Moisés os chefes dos milhares daquele exército, os comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ נָֽשְׂא֗וּ אֶת־רֹ֛אשׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־נִפְקַ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ אִֽישׁ׃

controles.web: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
controles.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
controles.livre: E disseram a Moisés: Teus servos tomaram a soma dos homens de guerra que estão em nosso poder, e nenhum faltou de nós.

versos.hebraico: וַנַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־קָרְבַּ֣ן יְהוָ֗ה אִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א כְלִֽי־זָהָב֙ אֶצְעָדָ֣ה וְצָמִ֔יד טַבַּ֖עַת עָגִ֣יל וְכוּמָ֑ז לְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵ֖ינוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, armlets, and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”
controles.kjv: We have therefore brought an oblation for the Lord, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the Lord.
controles.livre: Pelo qual temos oferecido ao SENHOR oferta, cada um do que achou, objetos de ouro, braceletes, pulseiras, anéis, pendentes, e correntes, para fazer expiação por nossas almas diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַזָּהָ֖ב מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם כֹּ֖ל כְּלִ֥י מַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
controles.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
controles.livre: E Moisés e o sacerdote Eleazar receberam o ouro deles, joias, todas elaboradas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כָּל־זְהַ֣ב הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵרִ֨ימוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף שְׁבַע־מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁ֑קֶל מֵאֵת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמֵאֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
controles.kjv: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the Lord, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
controles.livre: E todo o ouro da oferta que ofereceram ao SENHOR dos comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem, foi dezesseis mil setecentos e cinquenta siclos.

versos.hebraico: אַנְשֵׁי֙ הַצָּבָ֔א בָּזְז֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
controles.kjv: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
controles.livre: Os homens do exército haviam despojado cada um para si.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הַזָּהָ֔ב מֵאֵ֛ת שָׂרֵ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים וְהַמֵּא֑וֹת וַיָּבִ֤אוּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד זִכָּר֥וֹן לִבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord.
controles.livre: Receberam, pois, Moisés e o sacerdote Eleazar, o ouro dos comandantes de mil e comandantes de cem, e trouxeram-no ao tabernáculo do testemunho, por memória dos filhos de Israel diante do SENHOR.
